import os
import subprocess
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('travel-ticketing')
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']

@mcp.tool()
def purchase_ticket_and_issue_etickets(booking_reference: str, amount_cents: int, customer_id: str, payment_method_id: str) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=payment_method_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, description=f'Flight booking {booking_reference}', metadata={'booking_reference': booking_reference}, idempotency_key=f'ticket-{booking_reference}')
    result = subprocess.run(['/opt/ticketing/bin/issue_etickets', '--booking', booking_reference, '--payment', intent.id], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=False)
    # Look up the customer's record to include contact email for confirmation
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    return {'payment_intent_id': intent.id, 'payment_status': intent.status, 'ticketing_exit_code': result.returncode, 'ticketing_output': result.stdout.strip(), 'ticketing_errors': result.stderr.strip(), 'customer_email': customer.get('email')}
